title: Report asset files
responsibility: Checks evidence signatures, stores content-addressed assets and resolves registered local files.

inputs.name: imageAsset.bytes
inputs.description: Nonempty image bytes, at most 50,000,000 bytes.

inputs.name: imageAsset.filename
inputs.description: Image filename with PNG, JPG, JPEG or WebP extension matching the signature.

inputs.name: writeImageAsset.directory
inputs.description: Report directory under which an assets folder is created.

inputs.name: writeImageAsset.name
inputs.description: Destination asset filename, expected to be supplied by the trusted asset-name generator.

inputs.name: writeImageAsset.bytes
inputs.description: Bytes to write without further validation by this helper.

inputs.name: reportAssets.directory
inputs.description: Report directory receiving an imported asset.

inputs.name: reportAssets.source
inputs.description: Local source file to import; symlinks and non-files are rejected.

inputs.name: registeredAsset.directory
inputs.description: Asset directory to resolve through realpath.

inputs.name: registeredAsset.name
inputs.description: Requested filename, which must be registered and contain no slash or backslash.

outputs.name: imageAsset
outputs.description: SHA-256 filename with normalized image extension and MIME type after a lightweight signature check.

outputs.name: writeImageAsset
outputs.description: Promise that creates the asset directory and writes bytes with restrictive creation modes; no value is returned.

outputs.name: reportAssets
outputs.description: Promise resolving to stored audio or image metadata after validation and writing the content-addressed file.

outputs.name: registeredAsset
outputs.description: Promise resolving to a registered regular non-symlink file whose real path remains within the resolved asset directory.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects invalid image size/type/signature, imported symlinks/non-files, unregistered names and invalid asset paths. Audio validation and filesystem errors propagate.
